findings.issue: Component uses `typeof __APP_VERSION__ !== 'undefined' ? __APP_VERSION__ : 'unknown'` instead of the approved design's direct `v{__APP_VERSION__}`. The fallback is unreachable in production (vite.config.ts always injects the define) and untested (every test in footer-version-badge.test.tsx stubs the global via vi.stubGlobal), so it's dead, untested code that deviates from the approved design.md concrete shape.
findings.fix_hint: Remove the typeof guard and use __APP_VERSION__ directly per design.md, as already planned in plans/004-drop-unreachable-typeof-fallback-guard-f.md.

findings.issue: No test renders <App /> to verify FooterVersionBadge is actually mounted alongside CommandPalette (req 5.1-5.3). footer-version-badge.test.tsx only renders the component in isolation. The repo has a direct precedent (command-palette/app-integration.test.tsx) that isn't mirrored for this feature, so a regression removing/duplicating the mount would go undetected.
findings.fix_hint: Add an App-integration test mirroring command-palette/app-integration.test.tsx, as already planned in plans/005-no-test-exercises-footerversionbadge-mou.md — remember to vi.stubGlobal('__APP_VERSION__', ...) in that test if plan 004's guard removal lands first, to avoid a ReferenceError under Vitest.

findings.issue: Plans 004 and 005 have an execution-order coupling that isn't called out: if 004 strips the typeof guard before 005 adds an App-level test, and that new test doesn't stub the global, rendering <App /> under Vitest throws ReferenceError (vitest.config.ts has no define for __APP_VERSION__).
findings.fix_hint: Note the dependency explicitly in one of the two plans, or execute 005 first (or with a global stub) before 004.
